title: It's always a hotel or sprawling mansion for me
content: I often get lost, or I'm running late for an appointment in one of the rooms, or I'm trying to get packed to leave but can't seem to manage in time. Sometimes I'm trying to make it back to my room but can't find it again, and I'll end up in other rooms. On occasion it's a school or an airport. Once i dreamt i found a big basement under the school with an aviary, a pyromaniac room, a mask room, and a theater. It's always strange and disorienting, especially if elevators get involved. I dream about these spaces at least once a week.
